Availability on my side (all PDT):
- Today 11:00–11:30
- Tomorrow 09:00–11:30
- Thu 14:00–16:00

If none of those fit, tell me two windows that work for the week and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a very short demo clip and our one‑pager to save you time.

Attachments: concise-demo-90s.mp4 (video), redwood-pricing-one-pager.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
